table.name: Other_Available_Features
table.purpose: Lookup table of optional property features (e.g. air conditioning, swimming pool, burglar alarm) that can be attached to properties via Other_Property_Features. Each row is one available feature, categorized by a feature type (Amenity or Security).

feature_description.name: feature_description
feature_description.description: Human-readable description of the feature, e.g. 'Air Conditioning.', 'Swimming Pool.', 'Burglar Alarm'.

feature_id.name: feature_id
feature_id.description: Primary key identifying each feature; referenced by Other_Property_Features.feature_id to link properties to features.

feature_name.name: feature_name
feature_name.description: Short camelCase code/label for the feature, e.g. 'AirCon', 'Pool', 'BurglarAlarm'.

feature_type_code.name: feature_type_code
feature_type_code.description: Category of the feature, referencing Ref_Feature_Types.feature_type_code: 'Amenity' (e.g. Pool) or 'Security' (e.g. Burglar Alarm).

table.name: Other_Property_Features
table.purpose: Junction/association table linking properties (Properties) to features (Other_Available_Features), with an additional free-text description per property-feature pair. Each row records one feature attached to one property.

feature_id.name: feature_id
feature_id.description: Identifier of the feature attached to the property; references Other_Available_Features.feature_id (lookup: 2 = Air Conditioning, 3 = Swimming Pool, 4 = Burglar Alarm).

property_feature_description.name: property_feature_description
property_feature_description.description: Free-text description or note for this property-feature pairing. Values are placeholder/Lorem-ipsum-like words (e.g. 'quo', 'autem', 'corrupti'), so the real content cannot be determined; only the structural role (a per-row text description) is supported.

property_id.name: property_id
property_id.description: Identifier of the property that has this feature; references Properties.property_id.

table.name: Properties
table.purpose: Real-estate property listings: one row per property with its name, address, type, room count, market/sale dates, and pricing (vendor asking price, buyer offer, agreed sale price). Referenced by Other_Property_Features for per-property feature details. Note: values look like synthetic/test data (lorem-ipsum feature text, random prices/dates), so meanings are inferred from names and structure rather than realistic value distributions.

agreed_selling_price.name: agreed_selling_price
agreed_selling_price.description: Final agreed sale price of the property (stored as text/union type; numeric values, 0 when no sale agreed). Alternative reading: could be a display-formatted price field, but the sale-price interpretation fits the table's pricing columns.

apt_feature_1.name: apt_feature_1
apt_feature_1.description: Free-text value for apartment feature 1 of this property; the 'apt' prefix matches the Apartment value of property_type_code (Ref_Property_Types), suggesting type-specific feature attributes. Exact feature meaning unknown.

apt_feature_2.name: apt_feature_2
apt_feature_2.description: Free-text value for apartment feature 2 of this property; 'apt' prefix matches the Apartment property type. Exact feature meaning unknown.

apt_feature_3.name: apt_feature_3
apt_feature_3.description: Boolean flag for apartment feature 3 of this property; 'apt' prefix matches the Apartment property type. Exact feature meaning unknown.

buyer_offered_price.name: buyer_offered_price
buyer_offered_price.description: Price offered by the buyer (stored as text/union type; numeric, 0 when no offer). Alternative reading: could be a display-formatted price field, but the buyer-offer interpretation fits the table's pricing columns.

date_on_market.name: date_on_market
date_on_market.description: Date (with time) the property was listed/placed on the market.

date_sold.name: date_sold
date_sold.description: Date (with time) the property was sold.

fld_feature_1.name: fld_feature_1
fld_feature_1.description: Boolean flag for field feature 1 of this property; 'fld' prefix matches the Field property type (Ref_Property_Types). Exact feature meaning unknown.

fld_feature_2.name: fld_feature_2
fld_feature_2.description: Boolean flag for field feature 2 of this property; 'fld' prefix matches the Field property type. Exact feature meaning unknown.

fld_feature_3.name: fld_feature_3
fld_feature_3.description: Boolean flag for field feature 3 of this property; 'fld' prefix matches the Field property type. Exact feature meaning unknown.

hse_feature_1.name: hse_feature_1
hse_feature_1.description: Boolean flag for house feature 1 of this property; 'hse' prefix matches the House property type (Ref_Property_Types). Exact feature meaning unknown.

hse_feature_2.name: hse_feature_2
hse_feature_2.description: Boolean flag for house feature 2 of this property; 'hse' prefix matches the House property type. Exact feature meaning unknown.

hse_feature_3.name: hse_feature_3
hse_feature_3.description: Boolean flag for house feature 3 of this property; 'hse' prefix matches the House property type. Exact feature meaning unknown.

oth_feature_1.name: oth_feature_1
oth_feature_1.description: Boolean flag for 'Other'-type feature 1 of this property; 'oth' prefix matches the Other property type (Ref_Property_Types). Exact feature meaning unknown.

oth_feature_2.name: oth_feature_2
oth_feature_2.description: Boolean flag for 'Other'-type feature 2 of this property; 'oth' prefix matches the Other property type. Exact feature meaning unknown.

oth_feature_3.name: oth_feature_3
oth_feature_3.description: Boolean flag for 'Other'-type feature 3 of this property; 'oth' prefix matches the Other property type. Exact feature meaning unknown.

other_property_details.name: other_property_details
other_property_details.description: Boolean flag indicating the property has additional feature details recorded in Other_Property_Features (which references this table's property_id). Alternative reading: a generic 'has extra details' flag unrelated to that table.

property_address.name: property_address
property_address.description: Full postal address of the property (street/unit line plus city, state, ZIP), unique per row.

property_id.name: property_id
property_id.description: Primary key; unique property identifier (1-15). Referenced by Other_Property_Features.property_id.

property_name.name: property_name
property_name.description: Name/label of the property (e.g. building or development name), unique per row.

property_type_code.name: property_type_code
property_type_code.description: Property type code; references Ref_Property_Types.property_type_code. Values: House, Apartment, Field, Shop, Other.

room_count.name: room_count
room_count.description: Number of rooms in the property (integer 1-9).

shp_feature_1.name: shp_feature_1
shp_feature_1.description: Boolean flag for shop feature 1 of this property; 'shp' prefix matches the Shop property type (Ref_Property_Types). Exact feature meaning unknown.

shp_feature_2.name: shp_feature_2
shp_feature_2.description: Boolean flag for shop feature 2 of this property; 'shp' prefix matches the Shop property type. Exact feature meaning unknown.

shp_feature_3.name: shp_feature_3
shp_feature_3.description: Boolean flag for shop feature 3 of this property; 'shp' prefix matches the Shop property type. Exact feature meaning unknown.

vendor_requested_price.name: vendor_requested_price
vendor_requested_price.description: Asking price requested by the vendor/seller (stored as text/union type; numeric). Alternative reading: could be a display-formatted price field, but the vendor-asking-price interpretation fits the table's pricing columns.

table.name: Ref_Feature_Types
table.purpose: Small reference/lookup table classifying property features into two categories: Amenity and Security. Referenced by Other_Available_Features, which lists individual features per property, each assigned one of these feature types.

feature_type_code.name: feature_type_code
feature_type_code.description: Primary key. Short code/label for the feature category; values 'Amenity' and 'Security'. Referenced by Other_Available_Features.feature_type_code.

feature_type_name.name: feature_type_name
feature_type_name.description: Human-readable description of the feature category, with an example ('Amenity, eg Pool.', 'Securiyt, eg Burglar Alarm.' — the latter contains a typo for 'Security').

table.name: Ref_Property_Types
table.purpose: Lookup/reference table of property type categories, referenced by the Properties table to classify each property (Apartment, House, Field, Shop, Other).

property_type_code.name: property_type_code
property_type_code.description: Primary key. Short code/label for the property type category: Apartment, Field, House, Other, Shop. Referenced by Properties.property_type_code.

property_type_description.name: property_type_description
property_type_description.description: Human-readable description of the property type, elaborating what the code covers (e.g. 'House, Bungalow, etc.').
